column1: # Armoury: roadside inns (sw-zajazdy, Jeff 16.10: 'not too dense - the fewer people, the fewer inns'; f10-uklad, Jeff 18.10: 'not next to villages').
# Generated by tools/zajazdy/zajazdy_gen.py from the painted roads of ROT (arm_map_roads_geo.tsv), the AI routes of the geography probe 16.10
# and map villages v7 - do not edit. x/y = the stopping place on the road (where a party enters); bx/by = the building, front_deg = its front yaw.
# Places: crossroads on a painted road (a junction of painted roads or where a side track leaves it; main roads first), then long empty stretches
# of a painted road (16+ from any settlement), then AI tracks where no road is painted (16+ from a settlement). One rule for the whole world:
# spacing = 45 x sqrt(40000 / people within 30), clamped to 30..110; no inn below 12000 people, none within 10.00 of a map village or game village,
# 15 of a town, 10 of a castle, none beyond the Wall. tiers: 1 common room; 2 + decent inn from 45000 people; 3 + good house only at a crossroads
# from 110000 people. village_id = district whose purse takes the lodging money.
